evidence.V1: Front, three-quarter, top and silhouette all read instantly as a gate valve: handwheel ring + spokes, bonnet, bulb body, twin bolted flanges; outline symmetric (A15 X/Y error 0.0).
evidence.V2: Clear hierarchy: big bulb body + pipe run, medium flanges/bonnet/handwheel, small hex bolts, hub and collar rings.
evidence.V3: Confident stylised proportions: oversized bulb body, chunky flanges and an oversized handwheel; centring 0.0 offset and all 16 seats report seated with modest penetration.
evidence.V4: Rim, collars and flanges carry consistent chamfers that catch light, but the four spokes are square-cut unbevelled bars and the spoke ends butt the rim with hard edges (flat close-up).
evidence.V5: Mostly clean smooth shading, but the flange face shows a curved dark smoothing streak/pinch across the cap in the studio close-up, and the bulb body silhouette is visibly faceted.
evidence.V6: Disciplined: one body hue (teal) in 2-3 values, gold accent, ink-dark bolts, steel-grey stem; colourways swap only the body hue cleanly.
evidence.V7: 1,960 tris vs medium target 2,000 (ceiling 4,000): at target.
evidence.V8: One white vertex-colour material, kit gold/ink/steel palette, ~kit chamfer size on rims; reads as the same kit as other valves/props.
evidence.V9: Studio line: Anchored, CollisionFidelity Hull, CanTouch off, CastShadow on, MeshPart.Color white, SmoothPlastic, origin bottom-centre; all gates pass.

artifacts: Flange end-cap face: curved dark smoothing streak (pinch) across the cap in the studio close-up
Bulb body silhouette visibly faceted at close range
Spokes unbevelled, hard square ends where they meet the rim
top_fixes: Re-shade the flange end cap (inset ring + flat centre or weighted/marked-sharp normals) to remove the pinch streak
Add the kit ~0.045 stud chamfer to the spokes so they match the rim and collars
Add a few segments to the bulb body (or mark smooth) to soften the faceted outline while staying near the 2,000 target
